ayahs.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak.
ayahs.naturalMeaning: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak.

ayahs.translation: From the evil of what He created.
ayahs.naturalMeaning: From the harm in what He created.

ayahs.translation: And from the evil of darkness when it settles.
ayahs.naturalMeaning: From the harm of the night as it descends.

ayahs.translation: And from the evil of those who blow on knots.
ayahs.naturalMeaning: From the harm of those who blow on knots.

ayahs.translation: And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
ayahs.naturalMeaning: From the harm of the envier when envy acts.
